title: Users With Two Purchases Within Seven Days
description:
Table: `Purchases`

+---------------+------+
| Column Name   | Type |
+---------------+------+
| purchase_id   | int  |
| user_id       | int  |
| purchase_date | date |
+---------------+------+
purchase_id contains unique values.
This table contains logs of the dates that users purchased from a certain retailer.

 

Write a solution to report the IDs of the users that made any two purchases **at most** `7` days apart.

Return the result table ordered by `user_id`.

The result format is in the following example.

examples.explanation:
User 2 had two purchases on 2022-03-13 and 2022-03-20. Since the second purchase is within 7 days of the first purchase, we add their ID.
User 5 had only 1 purchase.
User 7 had two purchases on the same day so we add their ID.

hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Users With Two Purchases Within Seven Days.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
